title: Displayed pairing formula omits the coordinate within its diagonal.
details: Avigad, version 2007-01-09, §1.3 printed p. 11 (PDF15), example 6. Visually checked: J(x,y)=(x+y)(x+y+1)/2 is claimed to be a bijection N²→N. It depends only on x+y; (0,1) and (1,0) both map to1, so it is not injective. Repair for increasing first coordinate within each diagonal: add x to the displayed triangular number. The diagonal enumeration argument survives this local formula correction. Inspected adjacent source material; no new entry uses this erroneous formula. The corpus already has an explicitly proved triangular code and separately uses square pairing.
